title: Fix snapshot fan-out and CSV rerun outcome reconciliation
summary: Coalesces concurrent Local API snapshot reads, restores TX3G audit-result initialization, and safely reconciles uniquely sidecar-backed runtime-named CSV rerun outputs.
reason: A full Home refresh launched redundant snapshot builds that timed out under runtime load; the audit wrote an undeclared TX3G field; and title-aware TV output names were recorded as missing despite valid parked output.
behavior_before: Concurrent Home reads independently rebuilt snapshots, TX3G audit records could throw on assignment, and CSV rerun completion required an exact preplanned filename.
behavior_after: Concurrent reads share a one-second server-side snapshot, TX3G audit evidence is initialized, and a differently named rerun output is accepted only when exactly one adjacent sidecar matches the row source identity and staged input.
manual_validation: Focused regression RED confirmed, then targeted Python and PowerShell checks passed.
Targeted Local API, audit, rerun, parser, and lifecycle validations passed. Full reliability and browser Home smoke remain blocked by pre-existing guard failures outside this change.
Test-LocalApiLifecycleContractSmoke.ps1 passed; PowerShell parser and Python compileall passed.
rollback_plan: Revert the three production files to restore prior snapshot, audit, and rerun completion behavior. No source media, final outputs, manifests, or runtime configuration were changed by this code update.
notes:
Adds a regression for coalesced Local API snapshot reads.
Guards the audit result contract for TX3G embedded-SRT evidence.
Guards safe CSV rerun output reconciliation.
Coalesces concurrent snapshot reads for a short bounded cache window.
Initializes TX3G embedded SRT invalid-count audit evidence.
Safely reconciles uniquely sidecar-backed runtime-named rerun outputs.
Refresh generated summary for the targeted change.
